description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'ResetPasswordException' used to indicate that a user's password has expired and needs to be reset. It extends the 'PlatformApiDataValidationException' and constructs an error message including the user ID.

classes.name: ResetPasswordException
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating that a user's password has expired and must be reset, used within the platform's security exception handling.

methods.name: ResetPasswordException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with an error message indicating password expiration for the specified user ID.
